game_id_collation_order.note: Sample order follows localeCompare (ICU) over game_id, not code-point order: '_' < '-' < '.' < digits < letters, case only breaking ties.

shared_observation_id_across_games.note: Two games reuse one observation_id. The observation lookup is last-write-wins over the sorted event order, so game_id collation decides which sample survives.

missing_outcome.note: A control with no matching outcome_changed keeps null reward/score_delta/terminal/moved.

cross_game_observation_reference.note: A control referencing an observation recorded under a different game_id is dropped.

multi_chunk_differing_game_type.note: Two chunks for one game disagree on game_type/game_version. Both implementations key chunks by game_id, so the LAST chunk in the array wins for every sample in that game.

non_v2_chunk_ignored.note: Events in a chunk whose schema_version != 2 are skipped entirely.
